faqs: What does a solar marketing agency do?

We bring rooftop and commercial solar companies a steady flow of qualified enquiries. That covers Facebook, Instagram and Google ads, a website that converts, Google reviews and local SEO, video content and fast WhatsApp follow-up, all aimed at more site visits and installations.
What is a good cost per lead for solar in India?

It depends on city, offer, season and how strictly you qualify leads. Our rooftop solar campaigns deliver qualified enquiries at ₹60–80 each. The number that matters most is cost per installation, so we track site visits and closures too.
Do you work with solar companies outside Delhi NCR?
Yes. We work with 30+ solar EPCs and manufacturers across India and target campaigns to each client's own service area and pin codes.
Should solar companies use Facebook ads or Google ads?

Both. Facebook and Instagram lead ads give volume and let you explain solar with video. Google Search catches homeowners who are already comparing installers. Most of our solar clients start with Meta lead ads and add Google Search once tracking is in place.
How do you use the PM Surya Ghar subsidy in ads?

Subsidy is one of the strongest hooks in residential solar. The central subsidy is ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and up to ₹78,000 for 3 kW and above. We build ads and landing pages that explain it simply and check the current rules before launch.
How fast will I see solar leads?
Lead ads usually bring enquiries within the first week. Steady, profitable volume typically takes 30 to 90 days of testing creatives, audiences and follow-up.
